Largest aerial image of a flag formed by multirotors/drones | Guinness World Records

# Largest aerial image of a flag formed by multirotors/drones

Who

Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India, Drone Federation India, Botlab Dynamics

What

 5,500 total number 

Where

 India (Vijayawada) 

When

 22 October 2024 

The largest aerial image of a flag formed by multirotors/drones consists of 5,500 drones and was achieved by Ministry of Civil Aviation – Government of India, Drone Federation India and Botlab Dynamics in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India on 22 October 2024.

The drone-show took place on the banks of the river Krishna and held the spectators spellbound as images were formed in the sky.

Ministry of Civil Aviation - Government of India, Drone Federation India and Botlab Dynamics created 5 Guinness World Records at the Amaravati Drones Summit organised by AP Drones Corporation, Government of Andhra Pradesh.
